atDailyLimit: You issued {{limit}} personal tokens in the last 24 hours, revoked ones included. Try again later.
atLimit: You hold {{limit}} active personal tokens. Revoke one to issue another.
confirmEndAllBody: Sessions to end: {{n}}, this one included. You will be taken to the sign-in page. Personal tokens are not affected.
confirmEndAllBodyNoSession: Sessions to end: {{n}}. Personal tokens are not affected.
confirmEndOthersBody: Sessions in other browsers to end: {{n}}. This one stays.
expiresWithSignIn: This token will expire with your OIDC sign-in, at {{at}} at the latest.
fieldLabelHint: Up to 200 characters. Shown in your list and to an administrator.
issuedWarn: Copy it now: it will not be shown again. If you lose it, revoke it and issue a new one.
labelControl: No line breaks or control characters.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other web sessions were ended; this one stays. Your personal tokens are kept —
passwordErrThrottled: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
passwordHint: Enter your current password and a new one. Your other web sessions end; this one stays signed in.
revokeBody: “{{label}}” stops working on its next request. This cannot be undone.
revokeCurrentWarn: This is the token you are signed in with: revoking it signs you out.
sessionsHint: Each sign-in in a browser is a session. An ended session stops working at once.
title: Profile
tokensHint: A token for scripts and tests. It can do what you can do now: your roles are read at every request, so a role taken from you is taken from the token too. Your sign-ins are not listed here.
ttlCeiling: At most {{max}} for you. For an OIDC sign-in a token lives no longer than the sign-in, because OIDC groups are re-checked only at sign-in.
ttlFormat: A whole number of minutes, hours or days, at least one minute: 45m, 12h, 45d.
